actual_scope: Exact one-call/two-call lift counts above each fixed rank-one residue over every finite-dimensional central local F_q-algebra with canonical residue F_q.
scope_change_reason: The alphabet is retained and no new physical operation is claimed. This is a counting side result in the singular-target direction of #4601, complementary to the separately claimed zero-residue and invertible regimes.
bottleneck_link: An exact formal-alphabet census separates one-call lifts from lifts that necessarily pay a second call. Physical preparation, access, restoration, precision and complete supplier charges are unknown; this is not a mechanism breakthrough.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified uniform counting law and package it without extending to other residue domains.
evidence: PROOF.md proves q*z^2-q+1 exact cost-one lifts and z^4-q*z^2+q-1 exact cost-two lifts per fixed rank-one residue, z=q^dim(J). verify.py enumerates 63417 lifts over 152 residues in seven local algebras and checks literal one-factor images and attaining two-factor words.
